description: Classic Pong on canvas — rally against the AI paddle, first to 7 wins, with pause and speed-up rallies.

faqs.a: Mouse, touch-drag, or ↑/↓ arrow keys move your paddle.
faqs.q: How do I control my paddle?

faqs.a: First to 7 points wins the match.
The AI tracks the ball with a capped speed — rallies get faster the longer they last.
Yes — the Pause button freezes the game anytime.

howto: Move your paddle with mouse, touch, or ↑/↓.
Return the ball past the AI paddle.
title: Pong Game
